decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line bug-fix title, "bottlerocket settings taint format (#6489)" [ev-5506a0d4614a]. It does not give the format before or after the fix, does not say whether operator-supplied settings or rendered node settings are affected, and does not say what an operator would see. The rest of the Bug Fixes section [ev-664e993932dd] [ev-089778a9e2c3] adds nothing about this change. Calling it a behavior-change that applies "differently-formatted taint settings" is a guess: the fix could just as well have no operator-visible effect, or it could change how existing taint settings are interpreted. Deciding this needs the PR #6489 description or diff, or upgrade-guide text that describes the old and new taint format and what it affects.
